title: TEX
tagline: The onchain playground - weaving together everything onchain through an MMO as an onchain interface
description:
Visit DeFi's Town Square - your social layer, protocol aggregator, and platform for fully onchain games  ⚔️.
TEX is an accessible social DeFi interface that allows users to access anything and everything one would normally use in their day to day crypto life, exposed through a gamified interface!
